purpose: Teach: 短歌/防水/漁船/対岸/華人/バード/初演/見渡す

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、彼、本気で、絶対、短歌、習い始めたんだって、葵で、本気で、嬉しい、絶対、本当に、感謝、本気、本当に、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: Aoi, he's actually started learning tanka — I'm genuinely so happy about it, I can't even say.
lines.style: Open, warm spill of delight. Rush of words at the opening. Breathless on the middle thought. Soft landing on gratitude, like she's catching herself being vulnerable.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。新しい、本気で、防水のエプロン、絶対、買ったわよ、葵で、メイちゃん、本気で、感心しちゃう、絶対、本当に、本気、本気で。
lines.en: Yeah. I even bought a new waterproof apron — I'm really impressed he's sticking with it.
lines.style: Easy laugh underneath. Warm, conspiratorial tone. Light touch on the confession of caring. Pace quickens slightly on 'impressed,' then settles.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 港の漁船、本気で、絶対、たくさん、見えるよね、葵、メイちゃん、本気で、ロマンチック、絶対、感じる、本気、本気で、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: The fishing boats at the port — you can see so many from here. It's really romantic, isn't it?
lines.style: Drifting into reverie. Slower pace, almost thinking out loud. Eyes on the view, not the person. Tender and a little far away.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 対岸の景色、本気で、葵で、絶対、見えるんだよ、メイちゃん、本気で、本当に、お洒落、絶対、感じる、本気、本気で、本当に、絶対、本気。
lines.en: The view across the water is something special. There's such elegance to it.
lines.style: Soft agreement, almost protective of the moment. Nodding warmth. Voice settles lower, like sharing a secret. No rush.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、華人のお客様、増えてきたわよね、メイちゃん、本気で、嬉しい、絶対、感謝、本気、本気で、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: We've been getting more Chinese customers lately — it makes me so happy. I'm grateful for it.
lines.style: Lit up again. Pride threading through. Quicker tempo on the observation, then slowing on gratitude. Voice opens on the happiness.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: バードウォッチング、本気で、絶対、最近、メイちゃん、はまってるって、葵、本気で、本当に、応援
lines.en: I heard you've gotten really into birdwatching lately — that's wonderful.
lines.style: Gentle observation, no teasing edge. Warm recognition that Mei has a life she enjoys. Encouraging without pushing. Simple, genuine.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 劇団の初演、本気で、絶対、楽しみだよね、葵、メイちゃん、葵で、お祝い、本気で、絶対、しようね、本気、本気で、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: The troupe's opening performance — you must be looking forward to it. Let's celebrate it together.
lines.style: Inviting and present. Offer made softly but with real weight. Pace picks up on the eagerness, then opens on the invitation.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵の店、本気で、絶対、街を、見渡すことが、できる、場所、なのよ、メイちゃん、本気で、自慢、絶対、本気、本気で、本当に、絶対、本気、絶対。
lines.en: My shop is one of those rare places where you can see the whole town spread out below. I'm actually a little proud of that.
lines.style: Slow, settling realization. Voice takes on quiet pride. Pause before the admission of pride — vulnerable, then certain. Trailing off with contentment.
